doc.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021

title: Teaching in New York and Manhattan School of Music
summary: Back in New York he taught privately and joined the new jazz department at Manhattan School of Music.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: innate mechanical skill. So it was just, I did a few things on my own and then started just getting back into teaching privately, and that’s kind of what I did for most of my New York career, I just taught a lot until a couple of institutions came along, Manhattan School of Music in the 80s and they were forming a jazz department and I was able to be on the ground floor of that. And then some other things that came my way, some adjunct things and some independent studies. So I was always able to kind of juggle the playing with my private students at that time.
